frozen_note: Registered before any real DEV_TUNE/Gold/A/oracle result was opened this Turn. No weight or config may be added or edited after such a result is seen -- a materially different idea goes in a NEW versioned file (v2), never a silent edit here.
tie_break_note: Informational only -- the engine (a4-reranker-engine.mjs) enforces ONE fixed global tie-break chain for every config, not configurable per-entry: reranker_score desc -> original_a_top20 desc -> original_a_rank asc -> wide_rrf_rank asc -> chunk_id bytewise asc.
feature_keys_note: Any weight key not listed in a4-reranker-features.mjs's FEATURE_KEYS is rejected by validateConfig(); any FEATURE_KEYS entry omitted from a config's weights defaults to 0.
